Author: Kyuuso
Name: Eureka Suite
Punchline: All-in-one Eureka suite: aggro radars, live tracker sync, bunny helpers and Logos & Loot errands.
Description: All-in-one quality-of-life suite for Eureka (Anemos, Pagos, Pyros, Hydatos). Features lethal aggro radar visualizers (sleeping dragon sound aggro, low HP blood aggro, sprite magic aggro, vision cones, combat cast alerts), real-time ffxiv-eureka.com Phoenix WebSocket tracker synchronization, bunny FATE timer and coffer markers, and Logos & Loot errands. Bunny FATE automation is unlocked by a privately granted access package.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Bozja Suite
Punchline: Save the Queen field operations helper: critical engagement tracker, fragment planner with market prices.
Description: Early beta. Quality-of-life suite for the Bozjan Southern Front and Zadnor. Tracks critical engagements and skirmishes with enlistment alerts, shows your Resistance rank and mettle, lists the forgotten fragments you carry and plans which fragments to farm or buy for the Lost Action you want, with Universalis prices. Field automation (skirmishes, critical engagements, Castrum Lacus Litore and the Dalriada through BossMod Reborn and Rotation Solver) is unlocked by a privately granted access package.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Zodiac Helper
Punchline: Companion for ZodiacBuddy Reborn: automates the Novus, Nexus, Zodiac and Zeta steps of the ARR relics.
Description: Early beta. Helper for the ARR Zodiac relic line that works next to ZodiacBuddy Reborn. Infuses the materia you hold into your Sphere Scrolls, hands your relics to Jalzahn for each upgrade, and farms Light and Mahatmas through AutoDuty, with Remon attaching the next Mahatma. Optional: AutoDuty for the farms, vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs, Lifestream for inn rooms.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Anima Helper
Punchline: Heavensward Anima relic: buys, farms and turns in for you.
Description: Early beta. Takes your Anima (Heavensward) weapons through their stages: accepts the stage quests, buys the Poetics items (farming Poetics with AutoDuty when short), runs the step duties through AutoDuty and turns the quests in. Needs AutoDuty for the farms and vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Manderville Helper
Punchline: Endwalker Manderville relic: farms Poetics, buys the upgrade items and turns in for you.
Description: Early beta. Takes your Manderville (Endwalker) weapons up to the stage you pick: farms Poetics with AutoDuty, buys the 3 upgrade items of each stage from Jubrunnah, and accepts and turns in the stage quest at the House Manderville Artisan, job after job. Needs AutoDuty for the farm and vnavmesh for walking to the NPCs.

Author: Kyuuso
Name: Phantom Helper
Punchline: Dawntrail Phantom relic: arcanite, exchanges, Trust farms and the Occult Crescent events you still need.
Description: Early beta. Takes your Phantom weapons (Dawntrail) through their stages: buys arcanite and the one-time quest items, farms the uncapped tomestone and the Final Phantasm dungeons with Trust through AutoDuty, trades weapons at Dodokkuli, and lists the Occult Crescent FATEs and critical encounters that drop the demiatma, dispellers and crystal paste you still need. Needs AutoDuty for the farms and vnavmesh for walking.
